purpose.value: measure the tensile properties (yield strength and ultimate tensile strength) of the S1100 condition for comparison with S1000, S1050 and MHT

key_findings.value: S1100 yield strength 827 MPa and ultimate tensile strength 998 MPa, both lower than the other conditions; the engineering stress–strain curve peaks just below 1000 MPa but extends to ~60% strain

unmapped_findings: S1100 was produced 'For comparison of tensile properties only' — it was not subjected to the full microstructural characterization (SEM/EBSD/TEM) or the Charpy impact testing performed on S1000, S1050 and MHT, so no grain size, grain-boundary fraction, precipitate or impact-energy data are reported for this sample.

From Fig. 4(a) the S1100 (cyan) engineering stress–strain curve peaks just below the 1000 MPa gridline and extends furthest, to about 60% strain; however no numeric total-elongation value for S1100 is given in the text or in Table 1 (which reports only S1000, S1050 and MHT).
